finding.allow_update_by_address.descript: Zone {{zone}} accepts dynamic updates from addresses: {{addresses}}.
finding.allow_update_by_address.risk: Clients updating by address only are refused afterwards; they need a TSIG key.
finding.manual.remote_listener: Restrict {{subject}} by hand (allow list or firewall) on the BIND host: Pelagos reaches it over the network, so moving it to 127.0.0.1 would cut Pelagos off.
finding.dnssec_validation_off.risk: Answers from broken or misconfigured signed zones become SERVFAIL for recursive clients.
finding.kea_ctrl_agent_http.description: kea-ctrl-agent serves the Kea API in clear HTTP on {{address}}.
finding.kea_ctrl_agent_http.description_: kea-ctrl-agent serves the Kea API in clear HTTP on {{address}} without authentication.
finding.kea_ctrl_agent_http.proposal: Stop and disable kea-ctrl-agent: Pelagos uses the Unix control sockets of each daemon.
finding.kea_ctrl_agent_http.risk: Tools that talk to the agent over HTTP (Stork, scripts) stop working; give them HTTPS with trust-anchor, cert-file and cert-required instead.
finding.kea_http_socket_plain.descriptio: {{engine}} exposes its control channel in clear HTTP on {{address}}.
finding.kea_http_socket_plain.proposal: Switch the socket to https with trust-anchor, cert-file, key-file and cert-required, or bind it to 127.0.0.1.
finding.kea_http_socket_plain.risk: Remote clients of this socket need certificates.
finding.bind_file_mode.description: {{what}} with a loose mode or owner: {{items}}.
finding.bind_file_mode.risk: named keeps reading its configuration and keys and writing its zones: each change is checked as the BIND user, and every change of the step is undone if one check fails.
finding.version_disclosed.description: version.bind (CHAOS TXT) gives the exact BIND release ({{version}}) to any client, which helps match it against advisories.
finding.version_disclosed.risk: None: monitoring that reads version.bind gets "none".
finding.kea_ha_listener_open.description: The {{engine}} HA listener on {{address}} takes commands from any host that reaches it: {{exposure}}.
The {{engine}} HA listener on {{address}} would take commands from any host ({{exposure}}), but a firewall rule ({{guard}}) only lets {{allowed}} reach it: mitigated.
finding.kea_ha_listener_open.unrestricte: clear HTTP, no authentication, every command including config-set, dhcp-disable and lease deletion
finding.kea_ha_listener_open.restricted: clear HTTP, no authentication; restrict-commands keeps only the HA commands, dhcp-disable and lease deletion among them
finding.kea_ha_listener_open.tls_optiona: TLS without require-client-certs, so a client without a certificate is accepted
finding.kea_ha_listener_open.step_restri: Set restrict-commands to true on this node (configuration reload; the peer only sends HA commands).
finding.kea_ha_listener_open.step_guard: Load a firewall guard (nft table inet pelagos_kea_ha_guard, service pelagos-kea-ha-guard) that lets only loopback and the HA peers ({{peers}}) reach port {{port}}; it is removed again if the peers' packets stop getting through.
finding.kea_ha_listener_open.step_guard_: Let only the HA peers ({{peers}}) reach port {{port}} in the firewall (nft is not installed).
finding.kea_ha_listener_open.step_tls: Then TLS on every peer of {{engine}}, in one plan for the pair: a certificate per peer from the cluster CA in the Kea tls directory, https URLs and require-client-certs, the standby (or secondary, and the backups) first and the primary right after; if status-get does not show the relationships back in their normal state, every peer gets its previous files and configuration back.
finding.kea_ha_listener_open.manual_tls: Then TLS, by hand on both peers of {{engine}}: a certificate per peer (serverAuth and clientAuth) signed by the cluster CA, trust-anchor, cert-file and key-file in the HA relationship, require-client-certs true. Apply it on the standby (or secondary) first and on the primary right after, within max-response-delay, then check that status-get shows both servers back in their normal state; to roll back, restore the previous configuration on both in the same order. The HA listener checks no basic authentication, so basic-auth does not protect it.
finding.kea_ha_listener_open.risk: None for HA: restrict-commands keeps every command the peers exchange and the guard admits the peers' addresses. A peer that reaches this node from another address would be cut off, so the step watches the peers' packets and removes the guard if only drops grow.
finding.kea_file_unreadable.description: Kea files the pelagos service cannot read: {{files}}. Plans that change them cannot back them up and archives need the privileged helper.
finding.kea_file_unreadable.proposal: Give them to the Kea group with group read: {{commands}}
finding.kea_file_unreadable.risk: None: Kea keeps reading them as their owner, and the Kea group only gains read access.
finding.kea_socket_dir_mode.description: The Kea socket directory {{path}} is mode {{mode}}: other users can reach the control sockets.
finding.kea_socket_dir_mode.risk: Local users outside the Kea group lose access to the sockets (intended).
finding.kea_tsig_clear_secret.descriptio: D2 key {{key}} has its secret in clear in the configuration (Kea 3.x refuses this).
finding.kea_tsig_clear_secret.proposal: Move it to a secret-file (0640, Kea group) under the Kea configuration directory.
finding.kea_tsig_clear_secret.risk: None for DDNS; the configuration file no longer carries the secret.
finding.open_allow_transfer.description_: The options allow zone transfers to any client.
Zone {{zone}} allows zone transfers to any client.
finding.open_allow_transfer.risk: Secondaries that transfer by address only must be listed or given a key, or their transfers fail.
finding.open_recursion.description: Recursion is open to any client (open resolver, usable for amplification attacks).
finding.open_recursion.risk: Clients outside the local networks lose recursive resolution through this server.
finding.query_refused.description: named refuses SOA queries from {{address}} for {{zones}}: allow-query excludes the address Pelagos queries from.
finding.query_refused.proposal: Set [engines.bind] query_address in node.toml to an address allow-query accepts, or add {{address}} to the allow-query of {{zones}}
finding.query_refused.risk: Pelagos cannot read these zones through queries or transfers until an allowed address is set.
finding.rndc_nonlocal.description: The rndc control channel listens on {{address}} and allows {{allowed}}.
finding.rndc_nonlocal.risk: Remote rndc users (monitoring, scripts on other hosts) lose access.
finding.static_zone.description: Zone {{zone}} is static (no allow-update, no update-policy): Pelagos edits its zone file on the node that holds it (named-checkzone, serial bump, rndc reload). As a dynamic zone it would take record changes by signed UPDATE like the other zones.
finding.static_zone.risk: named then records changes in a journal ({{file}}.jnl) and rewrites the zone file itself: edit it by hand only between `rndc freeze {{name}}` and `rndc thaw {{name}}`, and its directory must be writable by named. Comments and formatting of the file are lost at the first rewrite.
finding.stats_nonlocal.description: The statistics channel listens on {{address}} and allows {{allowed}}.
finding.stats_nonlocal.risk: Remote collectors of the BIND statistics lose access; Pelagos reads them locally.
finding.transfer_without_read_key.descri: Transfers allowed by {{where}} leave {{key}} out: Pelagos cannot read the zone records.
finding.transfer_without_read_key.risk: None: the clients allowed today keep their access.
finding.update_without_admin_key.descrip: Zone {{zone}} does not accept updates signed with {{key}}: Pelagos cannot write its records.
finding.update_without_admin_key.proposa: Replace update-policy local by update-policy { grant local-ddns zonesub any; {{statement}} }; by hand (the session key then works from other hosts too)
finding.update_without_admin_key.risk: None: the keys allowed today keep their rights.
finding.update_types_narrow.description: The update-policy of zone {{zone}} does not grant {{types}} to {{key}}: Pelagos edits of these records are refused.
finding.update_types_narrow.proposal: Add {{types}} to the zonesub grant of {{key}}
finding.update_types_narrow.risk: Pelagos may then change the zone's name servers (NS) and CAA records, always through a plan.
finding.update_without_admin_key.risk_in: None: the keys allowed today keep their rights. Every zone inheriting that allow-update accepts the key too.
finding.view_key.description: View {{view}} is selected by match-clients { {{clients}}; }: requests signed with {{read_key}} or {{admin_key}} reach the first view that matches this node, so Pelagos cannot read or write the zones of {{view}} reliably.
finding.view_key.proposal: Create key {{key}} (hmac-sha256); put `key {{key}};` first in the match-clients of view {{view}}; let {{key}} update and transfer the zones of {{view}}; use it as the key of view {{view}} (settings dns.view_keys.{{view}}).
finding.view_key.proposal_earlier: Create key {{key}} (hmac-sha256); put `key {{key}};` first in the match-clients of view {{view}} and `!key {{key}};` first in those of {{earlier}}; let {{key}} update and transfer the zones of {{view}}; use it as the key of view {{view}} (settings dns.view_keys.{{view}}).
finding.view_key.risk: Clients matched today keep their view: only requests signed with the new key change view. Views selected by match-destinations or match-recursive-only are not rewritten; check them after the change.
finding.weak_rndc_key.proposal: Regenerate {{key}} in {{new_algorithm}} with a new secret and restart named.
finding.weak_rndc_key.risk: Other tools using this key (scripts, a remote rndc) stop working until they get the new key.
finding.weak_shared_kea_key.d2_proposal: Dual-key switch: add {{new_key}} to the primary's BIND, switch D2, remove the old key.
finding.weak_shared_kea_key.description: The TSIG key {{key}} shared with Kea D2 uses {{algorithm}}.
finding.weak_shared_kea_key.proposal: Dual-key switch: add {{new_key}} ({{new_algorithm}}) to BIND next to the old key, switch D2 on every node, then remove the old key.
finding.weak_shared_kea_key.risk: During the switch both keys are accepted; DDNS updates keep working on every step.
finding.weak_tsig_key.proposal: Replace {{key}} by {{new_algorithm}} with a new secret.
finding.weak_tsig_key.risk: Every peer using this key (secondaries, primaries, update clients) needs the new secret at the same time, or transfers and updates with it fail.

finding.kea_ha_guard_unmanaged.descripti: A firewall guard of the Kea HA listener was set up outside Pelagos ({{source}}): only {{peers}} reach TCP {{ports}}.
finding.kea_ha_guard_unmanaged.proposal: Adopt it: Pelagos loads the same addresses into its own guard (nft table inet pelagos_kea_ha_guard, service pelagos-kea-ha-guard), then retires {{source}} and keeps a copy of its files in the backup directory. The guard can then be edited from the security page.
finding.kea_ha_guard_unmanaged.risk: None: both guards admit the same addresses while they overlap, so the listener is never unguarded; if a step fails, the hand-made guard is put back before Pelagos's is removed.
finding.managed_drift.proposal: Adopt: {{object}} stays as it is on the node and becomes Pelagos's state. Restore: Pelagos applies its own state again.
finding.managed_drift.risk: Adopt changes nothing on the node. Restore rewrites what differs: a Kea configuration is tested and reloaded and rolled back if the test fails; a guard is put back as it was if the peers' packets stop getting through.
finding.shared_key_divergence.descriptio: Key {{key}} in keys.conf on {{node}} differs from the shared secret of cluster.toml: transfers and updates signed by the other nodes fail on this node.
finding.shared_key_divergence.proposal: Rewrite key {{key}} in keys.conf with the secret of cluster.toml (hmac-sha256) and reload named (rndc reconfig).
finding.shared_key_divergence.risk: named-checkconf validates the file first and it is put back if the check or the reload fails. A client outside the cluster that signs with this node's current secret of {{key}} is refused afterwards: give it the shared secret.
